pages.title: A Field Discovery
pages.text: The page carries several hands. One measured a quarter-turn with cords, another reduced it to four residues, and a third drew the same action as a rune.$(br2)No hand claims the first proof. Together they record that a direction can be transformed while its length remains witnessed.

pages.title: Recovered Construction
pages.text: Reading the manuscript adds $(thing)The Rotated Horizon$() to your field ledger.$(br2)It reveals the cyclic element and its action on a vector, the $(thing)Quarter Turn$() Theorem, and the matching Laboratory Form.$(br2)Duplicate copies remain readable and are not consumed.
